title: Microsoft Purview: network DLP policies for all websites through Entra Internet Access
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned all-websites scope from the documented network DLP controls, licensing and inspection limits. Two minor corrections would complete the enforcement path and update the device-prerequisite wording to reflect the current linked documentation.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans this network DLP scope through Entra GSA Internet Access integration.
claims.quote: admins can scope their network data security data loss prevention policies, integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access

Use https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/global-secure-access/how-to-network-content-filtering for its docs, whose DLP procedure gives this route without the walkthrough's scenario-specific user inclusions.

claims.where: Governance controls; rationale: impact; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: GSA enforces Purview DLP decisions on routed traffic.
claims.quote: Purview evaluates the content against your DLP policy and returns a decision based on your DLP rule action. Global Secure Access then enforces the result.
